summary: Full-stack E2E test of UsahaKu (Phases 1-3). Backend: 30 pytest cases across auth, websites/products, AI generate+ai-edit, publish, public site, trial expiry/maintenance, owner-access, payments, admin panel and cross-user security -> 29 passed, 1 failed (no brute-force lockout). Frontend: landing+nav, register->trial banner, 3-step wizard with AI generate, website detail (device toggles, AI suggestions, AI edit, publish), public site (WhatsApp/products/Maps), manual edit save, subscription+manual payment (proof upload, PENDING, WhatsApp CTA), admin login/overview/payments approve/users search+actions/plans/settings/activity-logs/websites, and full maintenance -> owner-access -> subscribe -> approve -> site online chain. One CRITICAL backend blocker found and fixed by me (unique slug index collision on empty draft slugs made every 2nd draft website creation return 500).

critical.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: startup created unique+sparse index on `slug` while new drafts are inserted with slug="" -> DuplicateKeyError (500 'Internal Server Error') for every draft after the first one platform-wide. Website creation was completely broken. Changed index to unique partial index {slug: {$gt: ''}} (server.py startup). Please review/keep this fix and consider storing slug=None for drafts.

minor.issue: No brute-force protection: 6+ consecutive wrong passwords all return 401, no lockout/throttle (playbook requires lockout after 5 failures).
Admin seed only inserts when missing; if ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env changes the existing admin hash is never updated (playbook requires idempotent update).
allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True ignores CORS_ORIGINS env var; should use explicit origins from env.
Does not call refresh_status, so it can report stale 'TRIAL_ACTIVE' for an owner whose trial already lapsed (until /auth/me or /public/{slug} runs first).
No auth/ownership check - any anonymous caller with a file id can download payment proofs; also uses blocking `requests` inside async handlers (init_storage/put/get) which blocks the event loop.

ui_bugs.issue: Label 'Alasan (untuk penolakan)' overlaps the reject textarea/placeholder (text collides) - broken label/textarea layout

PDF proofs are detected by `proofUrl.endsWith('.pdf')` but upload URLs are /api/uploads/{uuid} with no extension, so a PDF proof renders inside and shows as a broken image instead of the 'Buka PDF' link. Use the stored contentType instead.
Current-plan card shows 'Kuota 1 website · Berakhir -' (missing date) when status is TRIAL_EXPIRED
Tool emoji icon renders as tofu/broken glyph boxes in the maintenance card header

integration_issues.issue: Proof image takes ~5-6s to appear (backend proxies object storage) with no skeleton/loading state; looks like an empty 'BUKTI TRANSFER' panel meanwhile

issues: Hero title is clipped at the top of the hero band (first line cut off) at 1920x1080
'Pesan Sekarang' CTA renders outside/below the hero image band and overlaps the next section
Left brand panel content is bottom-anchored leaving a very large empty area at the top

action_items: Review the slug index fix in server.py startup (drop slug_1, create unique partial index on non-empty slug); ideally also stop writing slug="" for drafts.
Add login brute-force lockout (5 failed attempts) as required by the auth playbook.
Make seed_admin idempotent: update existing admin password hash when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes.
Restrict CORS to CORS_ORIGINS from env instead of allow_origin_regex='.*' with credentials.
Protect GET /api/uploads/{id} with auth/ownership (payment proofs are publicly downloadable by id).
Detect PDF proofs via stored contentType, not URL extension.
Fix public-site hero clipping/CTA overflow and show trial end date on the expired subscription status card.
Call refresh_status inside /owner-access so the owner page never shows a stale TRIAL_ACTIVE.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 720 lines and mixes auth, websites, AI, payments, admin, settings and storage - split into routers/modules (routes/, services/) before it grows further.
Storage calls use blocking `requests` inside async FastAPI handlers (upload_file, download_file, init_storage) - move to httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_executor to avoid blocking the event loop.
ai_json() json.loads on raw model output with no schema validation; a malformed field (e.g. non-hex color) is written straight into themeConfig. Validate with a Pydantic model.
quota_for() returns websiteQuota for TRIAL_ACTIVE users, so an admin add_quota on a trial user silently raises trial limits - confirm intended.
Frontend wizard swallows AI generation failures (`catch {}`) with no user feedback; the user only finds out on the detail page.

Emails must NOT use reserved TLDs like .test (EmailStr rejects them) - use @qa-usahaku.com. Publish navigates straight to /site/{slug}; 'open-public-link' only exists when returning to the detail page. Untested/not re-verified: admin reject flow via UI, notifications page UI, forgot/reset password UI pages, logo/cover/product image uploads via UI, mobile viewport layouts.
rca_of_the_issue: Website creation 500s: startup created `unique+sparse` index on websites.slug, but sparse only skips missing fields - drafts are inserted with slug="" so the second draft in the whole database triggered DuplicateKeyError E11000 (dup key {slug: ''}). Replaced with a unique partial index filtered on {slug: {$gt: ''}}; after the fix two users creating drafts concurrently both succeed and publish-time slug uniqueness is still enforced.
